notes: NEW Nearly 10,000 loops: every chord progression (60+) paired with dozens of rhythms, bass lines, arpeggios and melodies, plus hundreds of drum grooves and variations. Search by any word (style, instrument, mood), filter by mood, and star your favourites

NEW Loop Builder: pick drums, chords, bass, an arpeggio or a melody, choose the progression, rhythm, sound, register, swing and feel, hear it, then add it to your song or keep it under Loops > Mine. 'Surprise me' rolls a fresh idea
NEW Sound Lab (press 7): play any instrument or drum hit as a single tone, shape it with every knob in one place, save it under My sounds, turn it into a sample, or save it as a WAV
NEW Per-hit drum shaping: level, tune, length, filter, pan and play-backwards for every pad (right-click a pad name in the beat editor)
My sounds appear at the top of the Sounds list on any track
